entries.lifecycleBadge: Per-Task Verified Bundle (JS Dynamic Import + Wasm Re-Instantiate)
entries.jsSteadyStateBehavior: Re-fetches, hashes, and dynamically imports a fresh Blob / cache-busted JS module on each message
entries.wasmSteadyStateBehavior: Re-fetches & hashes runtime bundle and calls WebAssembly.compile/instantiate (plus glue init) on each message
entries.summaryNote: Reused worker re-fetches and hash-verifies runtime sources per message (evaluating fresh JS Blob/query modules for JS and compiling/instantiating fresh Wasm + glue per Wasm message).

entries.lifecycleBadge: In-Page Kernel Only (No Worker Task Pipeline)
entries.jsSteadyStateBehavior: Pre-imported ES module timed directly in-page via multilang-runner
entries.wasmSteadyStateBehavior: Pre-instantiated WebAssembly.Instance timed directly in-page
entries.summaryNote: Runs exclusively in Kernel Compute scope via /multilang-runner.js with pre-instantiated engines and zero worker IPC.
